metadata.description: Generic, installation-agnostic Agent Skills for Identity & Access Management: One Identity, OpenText/NetIQ IDM & Access Manager, enterprise PKI and Wazuh.

plugins.name: one-identity
plugins.description: One Identity suite: Identity Manager (IGA) administration and Designer customization, Active Roles, OneLogin, Password Manager, Safeguard (PAM) and Starling.

plugins.name: opentext-identity
plugins.description: OpenText (NetIQ) Identity Manager and Access Manager: identity servers, drivers, workflow forms, NAM configuration and IDM/NAM health checks.

plugins.name: enterprise-pki
plugins.description: Enterprise certificate handling: keystores (JKS/PKCS12), keytool, OpenSSL, CSRs, SANs, trust chains and renewals for Java/LDAP/identity platforms.

plugins.name: security-operations
plugins.description: Security operations: Wazuh SIEM/XDR deployment, agents, rules/decoders, API and SOAR integrations.
